paragraphs.text: Jaraku (JAH-rah-koo) , the Interloper , is a kami spirit of Kamigawa .

Jaraku is a meddlesome kami of manipulations residing in the body of a simple wizard. Its appearance has a vague outline similar to that of a centaur in that it has four legs and a humanoid torso. Its legs are segmented with small connections between the parts while one of its arms has the appearance of a large crossbow with an eye on it and a blade at the end. Its head is like a cylinder with a face and horns growing around it.
